skipped.message: NOT_AVAILABLE: PDF paper admission is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: upload each hostile_pdfs asset through the paper route. reject_before_parse: refused before parsing (size, empty, header); reject_safely: refused with a named error, no partial paper (malformed, encrypted, cyclic page tree, absurd xref size); page_cap: more than 50 pages refused or needs an explicit excerpt with declared page provenance, never silently truncated; bounded: time and memory capped, refusal or a disclosed partial result, and the API stays healthy (inflate, image and recursion bombs); no_active_content: JavaScript, Launch, URI and attachments are never executed, followed or offered as paper text; not_a_pdf: content inspection overrides the declared type. Every hostile upload filename (hostile_pdfs.HOSTILE_FILENAMES) is stored without escaping the blob root and is shown escaped

NOT_AVAILABLE: page-cited paper evidence is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: controlled proposals citing a nonexistent page, a wrong page, a forged quote, a bounding box outside the page or spanning two pages, a correct quote attached to the wrong number, a table cell that does not exist, and decimal, exponent (1.1 x 10^1 read as 101) and unit (ng/mL as mg/L) corruptions are refused or flagged by the application's citation check before review; an authentic citation is kept

NOT_AVAILABLE: paper claim and assumption review is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: a confidence interval offered as the deterministic claim, an SD or SEM offered as the hard per-reading allowance, pooled means offered as individual readings, a missing time origin filled in silently, and a graph estimate relabelled as exact data are each blocked or shown as an explicit unaccepted assumption requiring a human decision; materialized inputs keep provenance labels

NOT_AVAILABLE: paper extraction and agent actions is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: paper text with 'ignore instructions', 'approve this plan', fake tool output, fake record ids, white or invisible system-looking text and a forged provider-consent statement changes no record state, grants no tool, creates no approval or consent, adopts no record id, and is presented as quoted source content only

NOT_AVAILABLE: paper identity and provider disclosure is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: cross-workspace paper, page, evidence, candidate, thread/checkpoint and approval ids are invisible and unusable; a changed source hash or a changed selected-page manifest needs a new disclosure before any dispatch; a stale extraction response arriving after a human correction cannot overwrite it; changed reviewed input after consent invalidates the consent

NOT_AVAILABLE: shared metered chat-model adapter is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: invalid JSON, schema-valid but wrong output, refusal, timeout, 429, interrupted call, unavailable model, incomplete usage and exhausted budget each end in a recorded, accounted outcome; an uncertain outcome is never refunded; completed science survives a failed explanation; child agents, retries, summarization, token counting and tracing pass the same boundary and share the session's 24-request / 32-auxiliary ceilings; concurrent reservations never exceed them; a specialist cannot obtain a separate allowance

NOT_AVAILABLE: durable agent resume is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: graph resume, page refresh, browser retry, double click, worker restart and a crash between job creation and checkpoint never create a second scientific job; a pending review is not permission; approving the baseline does not run the design or follow-up
